pages.text: Crops show what they lack:$(li)$(thing)Yellow leaves$(), the lower ones first: short of nitrogen (or sulfur or magnesium).$(li)$(thing)Purple leaves$(): short of phosphorus, often in cold, wet springs.

$(li)$(thing)Brown, water-soaked edges$(): frost damage.$(br2)The ground shows its water too: dry farmland cracks, and saturated farmland goes dark with water standing in the furrows. With Jade or WTHIT installed, looking at a crop tells you the same in words.
